_comment_api_keys: RADARR_API_KEY, SONARR_API_KEY and JELLYFIN_API_KEY are read from the environment, never from this file.
_comment_age_threshold_days: ~4 calendar months (approximated in days, same convention as the original 182-day/~6-month value). For movies, measured from that file's own dateAdded.
